audit.why: 54.8% WR over 885 games for Naafiri — the best number in this slice. Lane bully with burst-then-nothing pattern; pack bodies eat his W stun and his kit stops scaling. TRICKY 7/10 reads harsh against the data — noted, not edited (mirror-coupled).

audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart gave Pantheon levels 1-5 and 2+ items while content and packet give every stage to Naafiri — and the full-layer whys under those Pantheon rows already described NAAFIRI winning (the exact self-arguing-row defect).
audit.why: His Q is 11s and W 13s at rank 1 — after one Q-W rotation he is empty for most of ten seconds while her Q bleed and E heal win every extended exchange; his E blocks only the front and his R is a roam tool, not a duel.
audit.corrected: Sides aligned to Naafiri across the chart with adjusted ratings; whys already matched the Naafiri verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: Naafiri's dash again miscredited to 'W The Hunt' / 'W in' across the content layer (kit: R is the champion dash, W the untargetable pack-empower). Cooldowns field had no digit. Missing interaction: his W combo opens with an auto-attack reset — the wind-up is the step-back cue.
audit.why: Kit authority; W Shield Vault 13-9s carries the autoReset flag, E Aegis Assault 22-18s is the lane's most punishable timer.
audit.corrected: Naming fixed, real cooldowns written, auto-reset tell added to dosFull[0].d.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): matchup-defining — Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Eviscerate has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Shield Vault is 13s at rank 1, 9 at five — a point-click stun; respect the all-in whenever it is up. - His Q runs 11s down to 8: after Q-W both fire he is empty for most of ten seconds. - His E block is 22s — the longest, most punishable timer in the lane.

edits.before: Pantheon is a lane bully whose early kill pressure comes from Q Comet Spear and the W Shield Vault stun, so the trick is not eating the point-blank Q. Bait his W stun onto a packmate or dodge it, then punish with Q daggers and W The Hunt once his combo is on cooldown. His trades are burst-then-nothing, so after he blows Q-W you have a long window to step up and chunk him back.
edits.after: Pantheon is a lane bully whose early kill pressure comes from Q Comet Spear and the W Shield Vault stun, so the trick is not eating the point-blank Q. Bait his W stun onto a packmate or dodge it, then punish with Q daggers and your E string once his combo is on cooldown. His trades are burst-then-nothing, so after he blows Q-W you have a long window to step up and chunk him back.

edits.before: Pantheon's R Grand Starfall is a roam and skirmish tool, not a 1v1 nuke, so in lane your R Call of the Pack out-duels him. Pop the pack when his W stun is down and W in; he has no sustained DPS to trade with a full pack and his E block only covers one direction. Six is your window, but track his R for roams because he'll try to make plays on the sidelanes rather than beat you straight up.
edits.after: Pantheon's R Grand Starfall is a roam and skirmish tool, not a 1v1 nuke, so in lane your R dive out-duels him. Pop W for the surge when his stun is down and R in; he has no sustained DPS to trade with a full pack and his E block only covers one direction. Six is your window, but track his R for roams because he'll try to make plays on the sidelanes rather than beat you straight up.

edits.before: At 2+ items you comfortably out-scale Pantheon: your pack DPS and W gap-close beat a champion whose kit is front-loaded burst with no scaling. His E Aegis Assault blocks one direction, so flank and W from his flank to bypass the shield entirely. Once you're itemized his combo no longer one-shots you, and you simply win the extended fight.
